ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-gray) regions punctuated by significant low-intensity (black/dark-gray) regions; approximate ratio of 65:35.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity region at the median notch extending medially into both lobes. Left lobe displays discrete dark circular clusters in the medial zone. Right lobe features a prominent, high-contrast diagonal dark band.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; interior angle calculated at approximately 48 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; minor pixel-level irregularities localized on the distal-right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the majority of the trailing edge, transitioning to a convex sweep at the distal lobe terminations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A cluster of approximately 6-10 low-intensity circular pixel groups located in the medial-proximal area of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant diagonal low-intensity linear feature on the right lobe; several thin, near-vertical low-intensity lines on the proximal-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, distinctive diagonal scar/marking across the right lobe; dense low-intensity pigmentation at the notch apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled transition pattern between low and high intensity pixels along the lower-medial edge of the left lobe.
